📖 How to use

  1. Add gifts with recipient, idea, budget and cost.
  2. Tick purchased as you buy them.
  3. Watch totals and remaining budget update live.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it work?

Add a row per gift with recipient, idea, budget and cost. Tick purchased when bought; totals update live.

Is my list saved?

Yes — your gift list is stored in the browser's localStorage on this device.

What do the totals show?

The header shows total budget, total planned cost and how much budget remains.

Can I remove a gift?

Use the ✕ button on any row to remove it.

Is this private?

Yes — everything stays in your browser.
